title: 雨上がりのホラー
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: square story-scene thumbnail for a Japanese Halloween illustration creator.
Create one completely original, meticulously HAND-DRAWN JAPANESE 2D ANIME illustration, square composition, without any typography. This is a Halloween horror narrative, not a traditional Japanese ghost tale or a photo.
Scene: a contemporary Japanese city side street immediately after rain, on the night a Halloween costume parade has passed. The actual celebration connects through the scene: damp twisted candy wrappers beside an open shallow candy basket, a half-folded paper bat garland being packed on a small doorway table, and a few wet shoeprints leading along the same street toward home. Warm light comes only from the visible shop entrance and its lamps, while the sky is deep midnight blue. Buildings and wet pavement share consistent perspective and shadows.
Main figure: a completely new adult with short dark plum hair, wearing an original simple navy vampire-party cape over an opaque ordinary outfit, walking home on supported feet with a closed candy bag. Their head turns slightly toward a disturbing puddle. Retain anatomically coherent adult body proportions and a visibly drawn simple anime nose/mouth, fine inked contours, opaque face color planes, two clear cel-shadow shapes.
Single horror clue: above the puddle the doorway has a folded small paper bat garland; in its reflection only, one bat-shaped silhouette is unfolded and larger than its real paper counterpart, as though alive. Keep every other reflection matching its actual source. The person is unsettled by this specific anomaly. No footprints climbing walls, no shrine, kimono, school uniform, Japanese ghost woman or traditional folklore procession. Halloween props are evidence of the completed celebration, not a lone pumpkin decoration.
Composition: figure occupies about one third of the square at left, doorway packing table at middle-right, disturbing reflection clearly visible in the lower foreground. Show feet contacting the wet pavement, three connected depth layers, no cropped head or limbs. Very fine controlled colored linework, painted flat anime planes, local reflected light on skin and fabric, rich deep shadows; never realistic skin, photographic rendering, plastic 3D or glossy photo face. No panel sheet, labels, title, text, numbers, logos, watermark or signature.
processing: Original generated PNG retained byte-identical. RGB JPEG q90/subsampling0 encoding only; no cropping, resizing, drawing or compositing.

replacesPreviousContent.reason: Replace general Japanese ghost-story imagery with an original Halloween celebration horror scene. Stable old asset path and lookup aliases are retained.

visualQA.scope: Only the scene/emotion preview role. This is not acceptance of final generated-image conditions.
visualQA.method: Direct full-size visual inspection of the actual generated image; file/hash checks are separate.
observations: 成人の顔を手描き2Dアニメの輪郭と色面で構成し、ユーザーの人物参照・実在作者名・既存キャラクターを入力していない。
濡れた路地、帰路の人物、菓子袋・散らばった菓子包み・片付け途中の紙の蝙蝠を同じ祝祭後の場所へ接続している。
壁を上る裸足跡や和怪談の幽霊像を廃し、実在する紙飾りと比べて大きく開いた蝙蝠状の像を水面に一箇所だけ置いてホラーを示している。
主役の両足と足元の路面が同じ場面へ接続され、足から離れた宙吊り人物ではない。
limitations: この見本の役割は選択項目の視覚説明。人物同一性、最終の指定画風や選択条件の再現性を証明するものではない。
反射・影は実画像の目視評価であり、光学計算による完全な投影一致は証明していない。
新しい原画の人物や衣装・配色を生成利用者へ転用しない。見本はHalloween祝祭後の出来事と空間の因果だけを説明する。
足跡には指に似た形もあり、すべての歩跡が厳密な靴底形になったとは判定していない。
